sections.text_helper: Section 32.6.13 "ADC regular data register (ADC_DR)" in chapter 32 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1557.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x040
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 RDATA[31:0]: Regular data converted
These bits are read-only. They contain the conversion result from the last converted regular channel.
The data are left- or right-aligned as described in Section32.4.26: Data management.
